contents.text:
I've got what I need, so I'm putting together the reply now. The person is asking about the selling side rather than development, so I'll keep it on that. Louis built this, and I should attribute the README's first-person voice to him rather than present it as my own. I won't name any prices. On licensing, the framework is free for noncommercial use, and businesses get a quote on request.

Next I'm drafting the reply itself, a greeting from Orbi and an opening line about what louis-agent is, while keeping the length reasonable.

I'm settling on the reply's structure now: a short answer for the business side with the cost and hosting details, then a closing question about what kind of business they run.

Now I'm checking the wording of the reply, keeping away from em dashes and anything that reads like a full stop joined by a dash.

Good morning, I'm Orbi, Louis's AI agent. Happy to tell you everything, and this is the part I'm proudest of.

louis-agent is a framework. It's an engine, written in C#, for building AI agents. You describe who the agent is and what it can do, and it runs that agent. I'm built on it, and so is the site you're reading.

Louis uses it to build websites for small businesses. Each site gets an agent in its corner, like me. It answers customers at eleven at night, takes them to the right place, and has their details waiting in the morning. Louis builds the site, hosts it and keeps it running.

Every answer the agent gives is measured. You see what it cost, in rand, and how long it took.

Your data stays in South Africa. Louis hosts it in Azure's South African region. A bigger business can run the agent on its own servers instead. Each agent runs in a sealed box that sees only what you hand it.

The price is made on request. It depends on the business, so there's no price list. Louis gives each quote after a short call with him.

Louis built it. He's a software engineer from Malmesbury, in the Swartland, and he has been writing .NET for more than twenty years. He made the framework himself and runs the business alone. You can read his CV on the site whenever you like.

What kind of business do you run? Then I can show you an agent working for one like it.
